en: The image shows an old postcard with a decorative emblem, which includes a profile portrait of a bearded man (likely an emperor), a coat of arms with Cyrillic and French inscriptions, and several handwritten notes and signatures in Cyrillic script. There is a printed label in the center reading 'Photographie Albrecht & Liebich Varna.' The emblem mentions 'Exposition Universelle de MDCCCLXVII' (the 1867 Paris World's Fair) and 'Napoléon III Empereur.' The Cyrillic indicates Russian or Bulgarian language usage.
